rows.note: Use 縮細 as the all-purpose verb for making something smaller or becoming smaller.

example.english: Shrink the picture a little so it fits in the frame.
example.traditional: 你將張相縮細少少，先至放得落個畫框。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 zoeng1 soeng2 suk1 sai3 siu2 siu2 sin1 zi3 fong3 dak1 lok6 go3 waak6 kwaang1

rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose term for a mental-health professional in the casual sense of English “shrink”.

example.english: With all this stress lately, why don't you see a shrink and talk things over?
example.traditional: 最近壓力咁大，不如搵個心理醫生傾吓啦。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 aat3 lik6 gam3 daai6 bat1 jyu4 wan2 go3 sam1 lei5 ji1 sang1 king1 haa2 laa1

rows.note: Use this for physical contraction or shrinkage in size, fabric, or materials.

example.english: This wool sweater started to shrink after washing, and I can't wear it anymore.
example.traditional: 呢件羊毛衫洗完之後開始收縮，著唔落喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 joeng4 mou4 saam1 sai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 hoi1 ci2 sau1 suk1 zoek3 m4 lok6 laa3

rows.note: Use 縮水 especially when clothes, fabric, or another material becomes smaller after washing or drying.

example.english: This sweater did shrink after washing, and now it feels too tight.
example.traditional: 呢件冷衫洗完之後縮水，著到我周身唔舒服。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 laang1 saam1 sai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 suk1 seoi2 zoek3 dou2 ngo5 zau1 san1 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use 瑟縮 when someone cowers or flinches from fear, pain, or an approaching blow.

example.english: They started to shrink back in fear when the dog lunged at them.
example.traditional: 佢見到隻狗撲過嚟，嚇到瑟縮埋一邊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 zek3 gau2 pok3 gwo3 lai4 haak3 dou2 sat1 suk1 maai4 jat1 bin1

rows.note: Use this specifically in retail or accounting for stock lost through theft, spoilage, or expiry.

example.english: This month's shrink is higher than last month's, probably because some stock expired.
example.traditional: 今個月嘅存貨損耗比上個月高，可能有啲貨過咗期。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 cyun4 fo3 syun2 hou3 bei2 soeng6 go3 jyut6 gou1 ho2 nang4 jau5 di1 fo3 gwo3 zo2 kei4
